UserProgress.title: UserProgress
UserProgress.description: Private cloud-synchronized learning progression for an authenticated Cyberland user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this progression record.

learnerName.description: Learner display name chosen in Cyberland.

completedIslands.description: Bounded list of completed island IDs (max 35).

totalXp.description: Total XP accumulated across islands, quizzes, debug tickets, and labs.

bestExamScore.description: Best mock exam score out of 20 (or -1 if none).

neutralizedAttacksCount.description: Count of distinct real-time attacks neutralized.

bestSpeedrunMs.description: Fastest completed Speedrun time in milliseconds (0 if none).

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public, PII-free Cyberland leaderboard entry for XP and Speedrun rankings.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Public learner pseudonym (no email or PII).

bestSpeedrunMs.description: Best Speedrun completion time in milliseconds (0 if not set).

bestSpeedrunCircuit.description: Label of the circuit for the best Speedrun time.

rankTitle.description: Highest unlocked Cyberland expertise badge title.

isPublic.description: Explicit opt-in flag allowing listing on the online leaderboard.

/user_progress/{userId}.description: Owner-only cloud progress sync for authenticated learners.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: PII-free online XP and Speedrun leaderboard entries.
